text: في الدقيقة 90+2، غيّر فريق Harbour City طريقة لعبه لزيادة الضغط والهجوم السريع، ورفعوا خط دفاعهم أعلى كثيرًا في الملعب لمواجهة فريق Seabrook Town المتقدم 3-2. بعد التغيير، استحوذوا على الكرة أكثر، من 31.7% إلى 40.8%، وهذا يعني أنهم بدأوا يسيطرون على اللعب أكثر[#1884]. رغم ذلك، كان في مخاطرة لأن Seabrook Town أصبح لديه فرص أكبر للتسجيل بسبب هذا الضغط العالي[#1884].

- Harbour City increased pressing from 0.6 to 0.78 in the last 1.8 minutes to chase the game [#1884].  
- Harbour City raised directness of play from 0.28 to 0.43 at 90+2' [#1884].

- Score was 2-3 in favor of Seabrook Town at the time of the tactical change [#1884].

- Harbour City, trailing 2-3, shifted tactics late (90+2’) to press higher and increase directness in attack, also raising their defensive line height significantly [#1884]. This tactical change aimed to disrupt Seabrook Town's buildup and create quicker goal-scoring opportunities.
- The increase in pressing intensity from 0.6 to 0.78 and directness from 0.28 to 0.43 reflects a move away from their usual patient short passing style within the 4-2-3-1 formation, opting instead for a more aggressive and vertical approach to quickly overturn the deficit [#1884].
- Seabrook Town, playing a 3-4-3 with a wide, crossing style under coach Mara Lindholm, likely invited pressure by holding a lead and maintaining possession dominance; Harbour City’s tactical tweak intended to counter this by forcing turnovers higher up the pitch and exploiting spaces before wide crosses could develop [#1884].
- The tactical adjustment increased Harbour City's possession from 31.7% to 40.8% within 1.8 minutes, indicating more field control but also raising the opponent’s expected goals from 0.55 to 0.99, suggesting riskier defensive positioning due to the higher line and pressing commitment [#1884].
